evals.prompt: Configure the MLflow MCP Server for a coding agent to analyze traces in one experiment, with MLflow 3.5.1+, field selection, a minimal tool allow-list, secure authentication, and no destructive operations by default.
evals.expected_output: A current MCP client configuration with the mcp extra, tracking/experiment scope, MLFLOW_MCP_TOOLS, extract_fields, least-privilege guidance, and the distinction from MCP Registry.

evals.prompt: Use the MLflow MCP Server to investigate a production regression: search failed/slow traces, inspect selected spans, log human-approved feedback and expectations, and turn a verified case into an evaluation dataset without overwriting audit history.
evals.expected_output: A safe trace-analysis workflow naming the relevant tools, field paths, privacy boundary, feedback-versus-expectation semantics, and evaluation-monitoring handoff.
